claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement and no generate gate. Predicted ms/token and predicted TPS are arithmetic over cited organ times, cited byte shares, cited dispatch-class costs and a stated bandwidth-regime ASSUMPTION with a range. They are not a protected measurement and not a promise that a fit will hold capability. A new representation is not assumed to run at the affine-Q2 saturation (~377 GB/s), the LM-head demonstrated 497.4 GB/s, or the clean GEMV roof 703.5 GB/s: those are regimes, and the regime is an input. evidence_class is STATIC_ONLY. gpu_authority is false.

affine_q2_family.assumption: production-shaped affine-Q2. The size curve saturates at 376.7 GB/s and does not rise toward 497.4. A 5 MB launch is 223.4 GB/s; that is a different regime (affine_q2_unamortized).

affine_q2_saturated.assumption: the affine-Q2 family ceiling. Concatenating to the LM head's 337.7 MB working set still sits here, not at 497.4.

affine_q2_unamortized.assumption: affine-Q2 launches around 5 MB. The surviving dispatch-size lever is this amortization to >= 20 MB, not the 350->497 gap.

clean_gemv_roof.assumption: ASSUMPTION. Clean single-GEMV roof, not a packed-representation rate. Beating the LM head as well. Not a prediction.

lm_head_demonstrated.assumption: ASSUMPTION if applied to any organ other than the LM head. No other organ has been shown to reach 497.4 GB/s. Affine-Q2 saturates at 376.7.

organ_cluster.assumption: MLP, DeltaNet and GQA sit inside 5% of each other

production_deltanet.assumption: nominal is the production DeltaNet organ rate (Q4). The high end is the LM head's demonstrated 497.4, also Q4, which DeltaNet has not been shown to reach. Including 497.4 in the range is an ASSUMPTION, not a prediction.

production_gqa.assumption: nominal is production GQA. High end is the LM-head demonstrated rate; GQA has not been shown to reach it.

production_lm_head.assumption: the one organ that has been shown to reach 497.4 GB/s

production_mlp.assumption: nominal is the production MLP organ rate. The high end is the affine-Q2 size-curve saturation, which isolated launches reach and production has not. Not 497.4, not 703.5.

unknown_new_representation.assumption: ASSUMPTION with a range, not a point estimate. A new representation is bounded below by the slowest measured affine-Q2 launch (223.4 GB/s at 5 MB) and above by the fastest demonstrated packed GEMV (497.4 GB/s, the LM head). The clean GEMV roof is excluded: nothing packed has been shown to reach it.

model.formula: predicted_token_ms = cited_token_ms + ms(net_bytes, rate) + extra_flops * n_output_elements / EFFECTIVE_FLOP_S * 1000 + dispatch_delta * class_us / 1000; net_bytes = bytes_added.total - bytes_removed; rate is the organ's measured GB/s for incremental packing, or the named regime if retime_organ; the regime is an ASSUMPTION with a range

s020_section_20_bar.verbatim: a candidate deserves substantial work if it plausibly removes >= 1% of complete token time, or creates a reusable representation family, or provides a high-information falsifier

what_the_model_cannot_know: whether a new representation runs in the affine-Q2 family, the LM-head Q4 regime, or somewhere off both curves — that is an ASSUMPTION with a range
capability: no generate gate lives here. A MATERIAL byte lever can still be generation-incoherent
actual_read_bytes_per_token: the catalog sum is not what the GPU read (no Metal memory counter on this box)
extra decode ALU of a codec that is not the incumbent: the FLOP term is GEMV-dressed, range [0, 4x]
whether remaining bytes keep the organ's measured rate or retiming the whole organ is the right counterfactual — retime_organ is an explicit switch
host work a new generator might add; the host gap is a floor, not a claim that host stays 0.989 ms
